Use case: stylized-concept. Transparent PNG game companion animation atlas matching the provided EXISTING GAME PLAYER and COMPANIONS EXACTLY. References are style references. The actual player is a very simple ROUND BLOB with extremely THICK BLACK marker outlines, half-closed circular sleepy eyes, tiny goofy open mouth with pink tongue, two cheek freckles per side, flat muted pastel colors. Match this low-detail doodle design. All characters round, silly and simple, 3-5 colors, no intricate detail, NO fantasy rendering, no fine linework, NO shine/glow gradients, NO 3D, NO sophisticated armor.
Create EXACTLY 5 COLUMNS by 4 ROWS, 20 separated full-body sprites. Every character inside central 70% of its equal cell, ample genuine transparent gutters. Same body scale and center for each paired animation pose, unchanged body outline except limbs/wings. No text, numbers, grid, floor shadow or backgrounds.
Rows 1 and 2 are 10 characters, idle pose A:
Row1 col1 GOLDEN GEAR companion: flat pastel golden round gear with 8 broad cogs, sleepy face, tiny feet. col2 KOREAN NEOLITHIC COMB-PATTERN POTTERY companion: simple round tan pointed-bottom pottery jar with black zigzag/incised comb lines and sleepy face, stubby hands/feet. col3 BRONZE SWORD companion: simple bronze green short leaf-shaped blade and brown crossguard, sleepy face on wide blade, tiny hands and feet. col4 SCORPION companion: rounded muted brown blob body with two small claws and curled segmented tail, sleepy face. col5 FIRE MOTH companion: round sleepy orange body and two pale peach flame-shaped wings, two black feelers.
Row2 col1 MOON RABBIT companion: round white rabbit with two short ears, sleepy face, holding tiny pale yellow crescent. col2 CHIMERA companion: ONE round green body with THREE simple sleepy heads: tan lion with scalloped mane, white eagle yellow beak, green dinosaur 2 cream teeth; tiny feet. col3 GOLDEN PIG companion: round pale yellow pig with pink round snout and tiny ears/feet, sleepy eyes. col4 SUN companion: round flat pale yellow sun face with 8 broad pastel orange rays, sleepy face and tiny hands. col5 EARTH companion: round pale blue globe with 3 simple pale green continent blobs, sleepy face and tiny hands/feet.
Row3 repeats EXACTLY row1 characters, animation pose B only: feet slightly alternated, gear cogs slight turn but face level, sword tilt a little, scorpion claws raised, fire moth wings lowered. Row4 repeats EXACTLY row2 characters, animation pose B only: rabbit ears tilted, chimera little feet alternated, pig feet alternated, sun arms raised, earth arms raised. Keep each face/body perfectly recognizable and same size as pose A.
Prioritize matching thick BLACK outline and simple sleepy player style.

Use case: stylized-concept. Transparent game projectile sprite atlas in EXACT SAME very simple thick BLACK marker doodle style as supplied EXISTING PLAYER reference. Broad flat pastel fills, black handdrawn outlines, tiny simple shapes readable at 30 pixels. No face needed on projectiles, no fine detail, no glow gradients, no metallic shine, no 3D.
Exactly 4 columns by 3 rows = 12 isolated sprite cells evenly spaced, each complete object within CENTRAL 65% of its equal cell. Genuinely transparent background, no text, gridlines or shadows.
Row1 left to right: small pastel gold cogwheel with 8 blunt teeth and center hole; simple tan curved pottery shard with 2 dark zigzag comb-pattern lines; simple bronze green short leaf-shaped sword pointing RIGHT with brown handle; simple dark brown scorpion tail stinger pointing RIGHT with small flat lime green poison drop.

Row3: small pale yellow sun with 8 orange triangle rays; round pale blue and green earth meteor with 3 small grey rocks trailing left; simple white eagle feather pointing RIGHT with pale blue central line; simple cream dinosaur tooth pointing RIGHT with muted green base.
